formattedAddress: No. 21-1號, Alley 16, Lane 559, Section 4, Zhongxiao E Rd, Xinren Village, Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan 110

text.text: A very good hot pot meal and enjoyed by all 7 of us. Very pricey meal as each person needs to spend $490 and each hotpot is around $590. They give you 30 mins at the end to spend with 3 capybaras in an enclosed area up the back. It was a very small area and the capybaras do not have natural dirt under their feet, just the flooring. They didnt seem to mind and were very affectionate. Especially when we had food. The food for the capybaras was free thankfully.

text.text: Three super cute capybaras and they go from really small, medium, and slightly bigger than medium. The hotpot actually excellent so will definitely recommend.

text.text: Went with high hopes of a good experience because of the good reviews, and it exceeded my expectations! We went during the weekday on a Monday, so it wasn’t too crowded. The hot pot surprised me with how good it was, and the sauces tasted very fresh! One hot pot meal set also had so much protein and veggies - I thought it was so worth it for the price and both my son and I were full to the brim! Meals also come with unlimited drinks, noodles, and ice cream, and the ice cream is actually really good (mango and strawberry were our favs)! The best part was of course the capybaras - We booked a 1pm late lunch reservation, so the lunch crowd already left when we had our interactions with the capybaras around 2:30pm. My son was there with only 2 other kids at one point and each kid had his/her own capybara to pet for almost 30min! The capybara encounter was free and the staff provided free food for the kids to feed the capybaras. The experience was so memorable and totally worth the money - Highly recommend!!

text.text: It was great place to visit. Only 13 mins walk from Taipei 101. Staffs are friendly and food is good! 3 Capybaras are so so cute! Just don't make a quick movement. They will get a bit scared. Suggest to make a booking before going! I was lucky to get a sit as I was going alone and get there early!
